news.title: BIP39 seed tool
news.summary:
Hi all, with all the noise about entropy concerns, I thought I would vibe code a tool that allows you generate your own seed.

It supports dice roll to add to the random generation as well as pass phrase.

It's a completely off-line tool and in clear HTML so you or your trusted AI tool can check if there is any suspicious about it.
